title: Volley Wave Decision
description: A question only a human (or the owning coordinator) can answer, published retained to volley/_waves/<wave>/decisions/<decision_id> while open and cleared with an empty retained payload on resolve. See spec section 4.6.2.

task.description: Task id, or null for a wave-level decision (e.g. wave_complete).

pointers.description: Where the evidence lives. Paths are on the supervisor's host.

on.description: What it waits on: a task of the wave, a PR, an issue (one or more).

held.description: Held (spec section 4.6.2): the decision stays open but waits on a task, PR or issue; it is never escalated, and the supervisor releases it when the blocker lands (a task done or cancelled, a PR merged or closed, an issue closed).

stage.description: stage_go: the release playbook stage (spec section 4.6.19) that runs only on go.

stages.description: release_go: every release playbook stage (spec section 4.6.19), each verified, with where its evidence lives. stage_go: the stages verified before the one it asks about, likewise.

host.description: repo_untrusted / remote_repo_missing on a remote host, and machine_down: the host's name (wave file or the hosts tunable).

target.description: repo_untrusted / remote_repo_missing on a remote host: its ssh destination. A repo_untrusted decision with a target is answered on that host.

claude_config_dir.description: repo_untrusted for an agent under a Claude account profile (spec section 4.6.11): that profile's directory, whose own folder trust answers it.

change.description: plan_change: what the new wave version changed about the task (removed from the plan, or moved to another issue).

repo.description: repo_untrusted / remote_repo_missing: the repo path the decision is about (on target, when set).

acct.description: account_limit: the Claude account whose 5-hour window crossed claude.warn_at_pct (spec section 4.6.12). agent_account_limit: the account record the agent runs under (<acct>@<name> on a paired machine).

agent_id.description: agent_account_limit: the running agent on the account at the warn level.

role.description: agent_account_limit: that agent's role in its task.

window.description: agent_account_limit: the window at or over claude.warn_at_pct: the 5-hour, the 7-day, or the weekly window of the agent's model family.

pct.description: account_limit / agent_account_limit: that window's used percentage when the decision opened.

resets_at.description: account_limit / agent_account_limit: when that window resets.

suggested.description: agent_account_limit: the account the balancing rule ranks first among the other candidates on the agent's machine under the threshold in every window that counts for it, or null. account_limit: the account with the most 5-hour headroom among those under the threshold in both windows, else a signed-in account with no 5-hour usage data yet ("no usage yet"; a signed-in profile before primary), or null when there is none.

down_since.description: machine_down: when the supervisor marked the host down, or since when it is draining, being removed or removed (spec section 4.6.14).

tasks.description: machine_down: the wave's unfinished tasks on the host, running and queued.

machine.description: machine_down: what is wrong with the host (absent: down). draining, removing and removed: nothing new starts there (spec section 4.6.15).
